title: The punctured comparison restricts the first matching-ring projection
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative local ring, $C$ its maximal-ideal adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], $U\subseteq\operatorname{Spec}A$ an arbitrary open, $q:Y\to U$ and $s:E\to\operatorname{Spec}C$ arbitrary scheme morphisms, and $D$ completion overlap data [def-sbc-punctured-completion-matching-sections]. Write $B$ for its matching ring, $a:A\to B$ for its base map, $m:\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ for its model map, $p:Y\to m^{-1}(U)$ for its punctured comparison, and $P:B\to\Gamma(Y)$ for the first ring-pullback projection. For $f\in A$ put $V=(q\circ\iota_U)^{-1}(D(f))$ and $W=(m|_U)^{-1}(\iota_U^{-1}(D(f)))$. Let $\rho:B\to\Gamma(W)$ be affine-global-section identification followed by restriction, and $\psi:\Gamma(W)\to\Gamma(p^{-1}(W))$ the pullback along $p|_W$. Give $\Gamma(Y,V)$ its structural $A$-action and $\Gamma(p^{-1}(W))$ the action through $\psi\rho a$. There is an $A$-linear equivalence $c:\Gamma(Y,V)\simeq\Gamma(p^{-1}(W))$ with $\psi(\rho(z))=c(P(z)|_V)$ for every $z\in B$. No finiteness or generator hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Tag 05ER, natural comparison Psi on coordinate projections; Tag 0BLH, affine chart setup. The restriction/adjunction calculation is supplied in full in Lean.

proof.text: By puncturedMap_over the composite of p with the restricted model map is q. Inverse-image functoriality, followed by U inclusion, gives p inverse image of W equal to V. Apply the presheaf to this equality and compose with the top-section isomorphism of the open subscheme to obtain a ring isomorphism H from Gamma(Y,V) to Gamma(p inverse image of W).

The definition of fromPunctured is Y.toSpecGamma followed by Spec of P. Apply appTop and the Spec-Gamma naturality identity: the inverse affine global-section isomorphism followed by fromPunctured.appTop equals P. The puncturedMap inclusion equals fromPunctured, and the restriction square commutes. Apply appTop contravariantly to this square; it says psi rho equals P followed by restriction to the inverse-image open. The top-section isomorphism and the open equality identify this latter restriction with H of restriction to V. This proves the asserted equation for every z.

The first projection of baseMap is the structural map on Y by the ring-pullback lift equation. Substitute baseMap(a) into the preceding equation. It identifies H of the structural scalar on V with psi rho baseMap(a). Since H is a ring isomorphism, preservation of multiplication now proves A-linearity on every chart section. Its additive equivalence with this scalar law is c.

from.place: The completion overlap matching algebra used in the punctured finite-model input; geometric affine chart/equalizer identification before denominator lifting, steps 1 and 2 of lem-sbc-punctured-matching-chart-power-lift. lean.statement:
theorem exists_matching_chart_restriction
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens}
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {q : Y ⟶ U.toScheme}
    {E : Scheme.{u}} {s : E ⟶ Spec
      (.of (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A))}
    (D : CompletionGluingData A U q E s) (f : A) :
    let V := (q ≫ U.ι) ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f
    let W := (D.modelMap ∣_ U) ⁻¹ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f)
    let ρ := ((ΓSpecIso D.matchingRing).inv ≫
      (W.ι ≫ (D.modelMap ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).appTop).hom
    let ψ := (D.puncturedMap ∣_ W).appTop.hom
    let P := pullback.fst
      (pullback.fst q (completionSpecMap A ∣_ U)).appTop D.toCompleted.appTop
    let aY := ((ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv ≫ (q ≫ U.ι).appTop).hom
    letI : Algebra A Γ(Y, V) :=
      ((Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op).hom.comp aY).toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra A Γ((D.puncturedMap ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme, ⊤) :=
      ((ψ.comp ρ).comp D.baseMap.hom).toAlgebra
    ∃ c : Γ(Y, V) ≃ₗ[A] Γ((D.puncturedMap ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme, ⊤),
      ∀ z : D.matchingRing,
        ψ (ρ z) = c (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op (P z))
